about_the_game:
Project UD is a multiplayer action game that combines asymmetric escape survival with high-quality pixel art.

In a city haunted by strange phenomena, you must play as explorers with various abilities to fight against monsters, complete quests, find loot, and escape.

Battle

  • Team up with up to 2 players and explore the city full of threats.  Of course, it is also possible to venture alone.

  • You must respond to various situations by combining various characters.

  • Use powerful and special consumable items to overcome the crisis.

Exploration

  • Get your hands on magical and super-scientific weapons that can help you fight against monsters in the city.

  • Retrieve the valuables you were asked to search for from the abnormal space and escape safely.

  • Explore various maps engulfed in strange anomalies.

Survival

  • Face various dangers such as otherworldly monsters, grotesque phenomena, and runaway mecha.

  • Use the various devices remaining in the evacuated city to help you survive

  • Obtain an arcane seal to get strengthening effects to respond to rapidly changing situations.

Progress

  • Develop various characters with unique occupations such as Front, Shooter, Mystic, and Supporter.

  • Set up various equipment to maximize your character’s abilities.

  • Complete your character’s skill tree according to your desired characteristics 

Manage

  • Run an antique cafe that attracts special customers in a city where strange phenomena have become a daily routine.

  • Assist investigators exploring abnormal spaces and help them escape safely.

  • Broker requests from customers looking for items that can only be found in the abnormal space and acquire benefits.

About Project UD

Project UD is being developed by a small team that loves a variety of Co-op multiplayer games, dungeon crawlers, and loot shooters. If you enjoyed Project Zomboid, Risk of Rain, the Diablo series, Strange Dungeon series and Darkest Dungeon series, Project UD will give you the pleasure of a unique new combination of the dungeon crawler genre in the cosmic horror urban fantasy world.

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i3-6100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 460 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Project UD combines extraction games and pixel art to create a new action experience. Explore a city surrounded by abnormal phenomena, overcome monsters and traps, complete missions, and acquire loot. If you work together with friends, you can deal with many more threats.
